title: Where Rounding Happens Matters: Rounding-Location Alignment Stabilizes LLM Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models often uses separate systems for inference and training. Even with identical weights and BF16 tensors, implementation differences can make an intended on-policy update off-policy and destabilize training. Existing remedies align the entire inference and training stacks, change global precision, or modify the learning algorithm. We ask whether aligning selected parts of the execution stack can stabilize BF16 RL while other implementation differences remain. We align training-side rounding locations with inference in three regions---RoPE, SwiGLU, and residual RMSNorm---by retaining selected intermediates in FP32 until their BF16 outputs. Across four Qwen-family models, aligning all three regions prevents the collapse observed under the default BF16 baseline; RoPE-path alignment alone also suffices in the studied runs, despite remaining numerical discrepancies. translated_title: 舍入发生的位置很重要：舍入位置对齐可稳定大语言模型强化学习
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的强化学习通常使用相互独立的推理和训练系统。即使权重和BF16张量完全相同，实现上的差异也可能使预期的同策略更新变为离策略，从而导致训练不稳定。现有的解决方法要么对齐整个推理和训练技术栈，要么改变全局精度，要么修改学习算法。我们提出这样一个问题：在保留其他实现差异的情况下，仅对齐执行栈中的选定部分能否稳定BF16强化学习？我们在三个区域——RoPE、SwiGLU和残差RMSNorm——将训练侧的舍入位置与推理侧对齐，方法是将选定的中间结果以FP32精度保留，直到产生其BF16输出。在四个Qwen系列模型上，对齐全部三个区域可以防止默认BF16基线下观察到的训练崩溃；在所研究的实验中，仅对齐RoPE路径也足以实现稳定，尽管仍存在其他数值差异。这些干预措施保持推理引擎不变
tldr: 该论文发现，仅需将训练侧RoPE、SwiGLU和残差RMSNorm三个区域的舍入位置与推理侧对齐（将选定中间结果以FP32保留至BF16输出），即可在保留其他实现差异的情况下稳定BF16强化学习并防止训练崩溃。
en_tdlr: Aligning training-side rounding locations with inference in just three regions—RoPE, SwiGLU, and residual RMSNorm, by retaining selected intermediates in FP32 until their BF16 outputs—stabilizes BF16 reinforcement learning for LLMs and prevents training collapse despite remaining implementation discrepancies.
